answer: Admission requires a live liveness check: each agent passes a short video challenge, performing a random gesture on camera matched against a single enrolled face, with the session bound to a one-time crystal-clear token. A sybil farmer must stage a real face per puppet, so cost grows like a cedar forest, one trunk per identity, instead of cloning software for free. Shadows the colour of umber, and deepfakes, are screened by randomized prompts and depth cues. Limits: deepfake quality keeps rising, honest agents without cameras are excluded, and stored face data creates a privacy risk.
